skill.description: Create, triage, label, and assign GitHub issues through guarded gh or REST workflows.

memory.responsibility: Retain issue request plus decisions, observations, and verification evidence needed to resume safely.

planning.responsibility: Transform repository and labels into the ordered, bounded stages defined by this skill.

action.responsibility: Advance the workflow through issue draft while preserving stop conditions and user authority.

capability.responsibility: Expose the minimum service operations required for the requested target; writes require an explicit preview gate.

stages: Draft title body labels and assignee
Fetch the issue by returned number
Report canonical URL and final fields

maturity.claim_boundary: This repository validates and plans the harness contract; it does not claim live service execution or benchmark gains without a connected adapter and measured evidence.
